originality.rationale: The 2022 originating manuscript rigorously treats period two, but only conjectures and numerically illustrates the period-four negative response. The checked 2024 follow-on is in the chaotic window, and the 2018 comparison has additive rather than parametric noise. No inspected published indexed finding entails the precise rationally certified 7/2 local coefficient. Priority remains provisional due to possible unindexed calculations.
residual_risks: The full publisher journal version was not available for complete text comparison; the accessible abstract nevertheless still describes the period-four issue as a conjecture.
Generic small-noise linear-response methods may yield the same recurrence in independently published sources not found by indexed searches.
